items.title: Kyren Williams: Completely overshadowed by Corum
items.text:
Williams rushed 12 times for 46 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night.

items.title: Blake Corum: Career-best rushing total in win
items.text:
Corum rushed 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown and brought in two of three targets for 21 yards in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday. He also recovered a fumble.
